discovery_notes: Chit fund (rotating savings) with a reverse/discount auction for the monthly pot: up to 5 members join, pay a fixed monthly amount, once all paid a timed auction opens where members bid a discount, endAuction picks the highest-discount bidder who receives pot minus discount and the discount is shared as dividends to other members, then payments reset for next month. Primary 184 lines; 27 it blocks incl. reverts and time travel. Local run on frozen HH env: 27/27 pass, 95.8% stmts. No imports. Licence file LICENSE (MIT).
